name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person: overdue statutory steps, meetings, proofs waiting, quiet files

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: From v_attention. Days are counted from the date shown; negative means still to come.
sections.sql: select ref, owner, item, detail, date, days from v_attention order by days desc nulls last

sections.title: Open tasks
sections.sql: select a.ref, t.title, t.owner, t.due_on from tasks t join appointments a on a.id = t.appointment_id where t.done_on is null order by t.due_on nulls last

name: deadlines
title: Statutory calendar
subtitle: Every statutory step on every open file, with the rule it comes from

sections.title: Not yet done
sections.note: Rules and sources: docs/compliance.md. Business and working days skip the holidays in the holidays table.
sections.sql: select ref, company_name as company, manager, step, due_on, state, source from v_deadlines where done_on is null order by due_on

sections.title: Done
sections.sql: select ref, step, due_on, done_on, state, reference from v_deadlines where done_on is not null order by done_on desc

name: money
title: Money and claims
subtitle: Cash held on each file, claims by class, and remuneration against approval

sections.title: Cash position
sections.sql: select ref, company_name as company, manager, currency, receipts_cents, payments_cents, dividends_cents, cash_held_cents, assets_to_realise from v_position where status = 'open' order by cash_held_cents desc

sections.title: Claims by class
sections.note: Lower classes are paid only once every class above them is paid in full.
sections.sql: select ref, class, admitted_proofs, lodged_proofs, currency, admitted_cents, paid_cents from v_classes order by ref, rank

sections.title: Remuneration
sections.sql: select ref, manager, currency, approved_cents, drawn_cents, time_cost_cents from v_remuneration where status = 'open' order by ref
